items.source: The aggregate root backing the projection is available in the target variable. A projection interface using @Value is an open projection. Spring Data cannot apply query execution optimizations in this case, because the SpEL expression could use any attribute of the aggregate root.
items.translation: 支持该投影的聚合根在 `target` 变量中可用。 使用 `@Value` 的投影接口是一个开放投影。 在这种情况下，Spring Data 无法应用查询执行优化，因为 SpEL 表达式可能会使用聚合根的任意属性。

`@Value`注解中使用的表达式不应过于复杂——应避免在`String`变量中进行编程。  
对于非常简单的表达式，一种选择是使用默认方法（Java 8 引入），如下例所示：

items.source: If the underlying projection value is not null, then values are returned using the present-representation of the wrapper type. In case the backing value is null, then the getter method returns the empty representation of the used wrapper type.
items.translation: 如果底层投影值不为null，则使用包装类型的当前表示形式返回该值。 如果底层值为null，则 getter 方法返回所用包装类型的空表示形式。

items.source: On method invocation, the address property of the target instance is obtained and wrapped into a projecting proxy in turn.
items.translation: 在方法调用时，获取目标实例的address属性，并将其包装为投影代理。

items.source:
A projection interface whose accessor methods all match properties of the target aggregate is considered to be a closed projection.
The following example (which we used earlier in this chapter, too) is a closed projection:
items.translation: 如果一个投影接口的所有访问器方法都匹配目标聚合的属性，则该投影被视为封闭投影。以下示例（我们在本章之前也使用过）就是一个封闭投影：

items.source:
If you use a closed projection, Spring Data can optimize the query execution, because we know about all the attributes that are needed to back the projection proxy.
For more details on that, see the module-specific part of the reference documentation.
items.translation: 如果使用封闭投影，Spring Data 可以优化查询执行，因为我们知道所有用于支持投影代理的属性。有关该主题的更多详细信息，请参阅参考文档中特定模块的部分。

items.source: Declaring a method in your Repository that overrides a base method (e.g. declared in CrudRepository, a store-specific repository interface, or the Simple…Repository) results in a call to the base method regardless of the declared return type. Make sure to use a compatible return type as base methods cannot be used for projections. Some store modules support @Query annotations to turn an overridden base method into a query method that then can be used to return projections.
items.translation: 在您的 `Repository` 中声明一个覆盖基类方法（例如在 `CrudRepository`、特定存储库接口或 `Simple…Repository` 中声明的方法）时，无论声明的返回类型如何，都会调用基类方法。请确保使用兼容的返回类型，因为基类方法不能用于投影。某些存储模块支持 `@Query` 注解，可以将覆盖的基类方法转换为查询方法，从而能够返回投影。
